a: Chat systems need presence, delivery, storage, and fanout strategies.
Feeds can be fan-out on write, fan-out on read, or hybrid.
Search uses inverted indexes and ranking signals.
URL shorteners map short codes to long URLs with high read volume.
Token bucket and sliding window are common rate-limit algorithms.
Leader election chooses one coordinator among peers.
Quorum requires a majority of nodes to agree for consistency.
Bloom filters probabilistically test set membership with low memory.
Consistent hashing minimizes key movement when nodes change.
Backpressure slows producers when consumers cannot keep up.
